en: Oh don't look at me like that, I'm sure you would've got your ass kicked too. I mean, being tough is one thing, but you don't just throw yourself into a fight that you can avoid. It gets things done, I'll admit, but shouldn't fighting be a last resort?
Shit really? Looks like it's my lucky day! Just let me know when you've got it squared and I'll be right behind you.
Shit, those things are huge! I'm glad I didn't try to make the climb, I would've got my ass kicked. I mean, I'm strong and everything, but at the end of the day, I'm still just flesh and bones.
Single gondola fits four, 100g. Not negotiable.
The lift works, and yes it's perfectly safe. It's 500$ per trip. Pay it or climb, I don't care.
The place isn't too bad really, though that might be coloured by my 'life as an outcast' thing. What about you? What do you think of the great and dreadful Lukatt?
Well, that's just great. Thanks for nothing.

Well, you've been a big help. Taking that lift shaves days off my travel time, and based on some of the stuff we saw out the window, probably weeks of recovery time too. Thanks again, and try not to get killed.
Well? Are we going or ain't we?
What the hell do you want? Come to gawk at the freak?
You know, that's mighty good of you to help a guy out. Not too often you meet someone on this island willing to do that for someone they don't know.
You're gonna get rid of that mongrel for me? Tell you what, I should charge you extra for the cleaning I'm gonna have to do later, but you're doing me a favor. Still just 500$.
As... statuesque as Paul is, surely he could have more consideration for the sensibilities of bystanders.
Bath chamber looks clear too. I think we're good.
Come give me a scrub, Perry. I'll do you too.
Excellent.
Glad to hear it.
Good God, I can already hear the blood rushing. I'll have a bath later. If I go in there now, I might do something I regret.
Great, I could do with a wash-up! It was a long, sweaty march today.
Hah! Is that so?

Have I ever mentioned how much I love this island? 
Because I love this island.
He's probably already trying to figure out how to get you out of your clothes, Paul.
Hey Paul, look! There are five beds. We can push two of them together for you and we'll still all get to have one!
Hey boss, did you say there's a bath chamber here?
Hey boss, you said there's a bath chamber?
Hey now, I can want to see what Paul is smuggling and genuinely be concerned for his comfort at the same time. Honestly, what do you people take me for?
Hey you better not use up all the water! You aren't the only one who's sweaty!
Hey, I like being naked around people too! Why the fuck do you think I'm dressed like this?
Hey, that sounds really hot! I wanna see!
Hey, what about me? Logus needs a scrub too, you know!
Honestly, I'm surprised you haven't talked Paul out of his shorts yet.
I ain't perfect, sure, but if you're gonna criticize me for something, at least criticize me for something I actually did.
I could use an extra set of hands, Peregrine.
I expect you won't mind if I join you? I could definitely do with a wash as well.
I guess that's our evening then.
I have never been readier for a bath than I am at this moment.
I love this island. So, so much.
I need to wash my hair so badly, I no longer care if Peregrine oggles me while I do it. Perhaps Paul will keep him distracted.
I really and sincerely want to see your caber, Paul. Please!
I was worried I was going to have to smell everybody all night. I like this plan better.
I'll wait my turn. After all, someone has to make up for the utter lack of modesty that seems to run rampant here.
I'm feeling a touch lightheaded.
I'm going to bed.
I'm not the biggest fan of water lately, but even I think a bath would hit the spot right now. Wait for me, Paul! I'll help too!
If you're not busy, of course.
It was a long, sweaty march today and I could use a wash-up.
Looks like it, yes.
Now this brings back memories! I think a bath is exactly what I need right now.
Oh goodness. Did I really just see that? And they're going to bathe together? On purpose?
On the one hand, it would feel a bit like crashing a private party. On the other hand, this is Peregrine we're talking about. He'll be thrilled to scrub another man down, won't he?
Peregrine! Save some water for the rest of us, alright?
Right you are! Nice of you to think of me, Peregrine.
See, Peregrine? Just ask the man nicely!
Seriously, we all stink. I just hope there's enough water to go around.
Shit, Perry, I ain't shy. You could'a just asked.
Sleep well, gentlemen?
Sometimes, yeah. This time I didn't say anything. I was just talking about Paul having a place to sleep that isn't dirt.
Sure did, chief.
Thanks. Fortunately for you, I'm also incredibly humble and forgiving. The very picture of a fun-and-attention-loving rogue, really.
That's me!
The door looks tight. With any luck it'll still be empty.
The giant is particularly powerful, so if keeping Peregrine around serves to maintain him, I suppose this behaviour is worth tolerating.
Ugh.
We take you for our perky little pervert. Our lovable rogue and cabin boy all rolled into one!
We're fortunate to have the opportunity to bathe indoors.
Well, I for one am glad to see my boys getting along.
Well, you know me! I'm a people person.
Well? Is it everything you hoped for?
Yes, I'm pretty sure that's what it is.
You certainly are.
You guys don't really do the bathing together thing, do you? Humans are so weird.
You're a pervert, Peregrine, and you like to announce that you're a pervert in front of all of us. Repeatedly.
You're right. Sorry, Peregrine.
Anyone caught stealing supplies will be driven out. We cannot survive if we do not work together. Thank you for understanding.

Some build bridges made of stone, 
some of wood and some of bone,
but they whose only chance has flown
may build a bridge of gold alone.
Do you twelve-thousand pieces own?
Ack! Adventurers! Monsters!

It seems my welcome's overstayed,
if I've encountered mortals.
Perchance this begs a getaway?
I'll use one of my portals!
Ouch! I-I gotta get out of here!
Lord Maxim Spartill
Adventurers. I'm going to say this once, so listen up. Go looking for trouble here, and you'll find more than you care for. Keep your weapons to yourselves, and you'll have no problems from us.
Again? I don't know how you're doing it, but I'm sure you're cheating me!
All's quiet. Boring, but it means no one's getting hurt.
Come back when you've got more money.
Do you have any idea what the word
Do you make a habit of staring at naked people?
Do you mind? We're in the middle of something.
Don't go messing with the garden, please. It's hard to keep things growing well down here.
Excuse me.
Have you ever heard a Saurian sing? One of the guards has a voice that sounds like... molten stone dribbling down a mountain's quaking thighs. Shame he's so self-conscious about it.
Here's your meal. I really should not have done that though, so if you want more, it's straight coin, sorry!
I don't think that centaurs are meant to dance.
I hate walking on these tiles. It feels like I'm going to slip.
I really wish they'd give us a damn folding screen or something.
I'll be keeping an eye on you.
I'm not really in the mood for an encounter right now. Please keep it down.
I'm one of the only people here who can actually read, to be honest.
I'm sure that the barkeep can fix you up something to eat if you're hungry. He's just over there on the left.
I've gone through all of these recipe books already. Most of the recipes need things we can't get out here, but sometimes it at least gives me an idea.
If you don't have any questions, I should get back to work.
It would be nice if there was more room in here for me to wriggle into this bed. Hmm.
It's hard to dance when there's no music playing.
Just make yourself at home. Nobody here is going to give you any grief.
Look, I'm flattered you want to socialize, but I'm working. Go bother someone else.
Oh, I've been looking for that one. How's about I trade you for this one instead?
Perfect. Enjoy!
That isn't yours. Hands off.

That's not enough. 

Pay, lay, or leave.
That's too bad. My meat's quite popular, you should get it while it's hot!
The bath is full, wait your turn.
The exit to the top of the cliffs is just upstairs.
The layout of this floor is obnoxious. Maybe it used to be some kind of trap? We'd change it, but we're afraid that it might weaken the tower if we started knocking down walls.
The price is 100$. No deal.
The weather's been harsh lately, like the island is angry.
This place is luxury for someone used to skulking about in ruins.
This probably goes without saying, but please don't go stealing our supplies. We've got little enough as it is.
"This statue here... I keep feeling I've seen this woman before, but just can't quite remember where from.
ctx: Coastal Tower.bbm displayed body, opening quote left unclosed by the script

en: We don't usually bother keeping captives, but occasionally someone gets drunk and needs a spot to cool off.
We get the occasional wanderer or merchant passing through. There might still be a few here, kinda hard to keep track.
We rarely have to throw anyone out. Threw a bunch of sahaguin out earlier, but they were real assholes.
Welcome to the tower. We're built right into the cliff here, so there's an exit at the top and at the bottom.
What part of
What the hell is wrong with you? Get lost and let us bathe in peace.
Who's there?
Whoah, really? Well, damn, let's get you horizontal before you change your mind. Your friends can hold down the bar for a few, right?
Yes, whatever, take a bed if you want one, just give us some space.
You can find the baths and the gardens downstairs, if you're interested in taking a look.
You looking for a bite to eat? I'll hook you up for 100$. Interested?
You think those look good, eh? Well hands off, they ain't ready, and they ain't yours.
You'd best keep your hands where I can see them, stranger.
do you have trouble understanding?
means? A madman came through here a while ago, and it was carved into his skin in several places. He was too crazed to answer me when I asked, but I can't stop thinking about it.
Don't try to cheat me, two-foots! That isn't my asking price and you knows it!
Don't you dare touch that treasure! I was here first, and it's mine!
Eh? Treasure? Yes, there was treasure, and a great one, but as ye see, the place is collapsed.
I though, I found the best piece, and hid it away, I did. You want it?
I've made up my mind. You pay me in gold, yes? For 10,000$ I will tell you where I've hidden the treasure.
Of course ye do, of course! Maybe we can work out a deal, hmm?
That's a shame. Lovely piece it is, just lovely.
Yes, yes all that shiny gold! But why, why would I give you the treasure for that gold when I could just kills you and takes it?
You'll be back, you will. The glorious treasure will be waiting for you!
... yeah I know.

A word of advice : last time I stayed the night in this bunk, I could hear some orcs from the military rutting like wild hogs in the next one over. If you want a scandalous story to tell people, by all means, stay. If you want a good night's sleep, keep walking.
Alright, I think we're all set. Come warm up.
And I, Bato, quietly admire your majestic eagle whenever you grace us with it.
Anyway, what does it matter? It's just hair.
At least we don't have to spend the night outside.
Attaboy!
Aw, hell.
Aww man, a body hair contest? Why couldn't it be a biceps contest? I'd have stolen that one for sure.
Bato, that's absurd. Your chest hair isn't what makes you a good man.
Bato, you've a very respectable expanse there, but mine is clearly more lush than yours.
Come on boss, help me out here!
Come on, Greave. You've got a brand now just like the rest of us, right? It isn't like your mother is going to know. Dry your clothes and we'll have our game.
Did we actually bring any vegetables, or should I-
Do you both agree to fully follow the rules set out by the judge in this contest?
Does body hair improve their suitability as servants, Master? Hmm.
Don't be absurd! I agree to follow the rules, on my honour!
Don't be so sure about that, Bato! It looks like there was more he was hiding from us. You may have some fierce competition tonight!
Don't get me wrong, yours is excellent, but mine is like a majestic soaring eagle. There's no comparison!
Excellent! This will be a perfect distraction from the wet chill.
Excuse me?
For now though, we're going to sit naked around a fire and eat our food like a bunch of savages, and it's going to be great.
Greave, lad, my bet's on you! I'm... extremely impressed with that.
Hah! I told you he wouldn't follow the rules!
Holy Lord, Greave! Where were you hiding that all this time?!
How are you holding up, Greave?
I already know who's going to win.
I am impressed and in admiration of your fine gentleman's yard, Greave. That's all.
I do love tests. Shall I come up with a few methodologies for you?
I do! Greave won't agree, though. I can already tell he knows he'll lose.
I don't know about that, Greave. You're two of the best men I know, so it seems pretty accurate to me.
I guess we'll know better than to try to ford the next stream. Today was the most miserable march we've had in weeks.
I know you're a better sportsman than that, Bato.
I love hanging out with you guys, you know that?
I love you both, and my poor heart couldn't take the strain of choosing between you.
I shall observe this contest closely.
I think we can afford to trade a little dignity for dry clothes tonight.
I'll get the food started. Let's see what we've got.
I'll go get started on the campfire right away, if you don't mind. I can't get dry fast enough.
I'm thinking Bato takes this one. Sorry Greave.
I... suppose you have a point. Um...
If your bracken is what makes you such a good cook, then I'll not argue!
Is this a thing humans do? I'll just watch, thanks.
Is this even still a competition? I feel like this was an elaborate ploy to get me out of my clothes.
It's Nonsense
It's True
It's not just about the amount, my boy! I have a broad spread. Well-centred, even coverage, and look at these symmetrical swirls here!
Just paying my respects to his majesty for a battle well-fought.
Not that old Greave here will have any left at all once I win!
Now that we've been seen together, it's not safe for us here. We're going someplace far away, and can only take whatever we can carry. Please, if you find this, put these things to good use.
Now, nothing shocks me.
Oh come on Bato, that's preposterous.
Oh goodness. I'll just watch, if you don't mind. You don't mind, do you? Of course not.
Oh how fun! I wish this was back at the stronghold so we could take bets. My money's on Greave!
Oh shit, are we taking our clothes off now?! I wake up ready for this every single day!
Oh! Can I play? I want to play!
Oh, come on, but-
Oh, don't worry. I'm still going to make you go through all kinds of tests to figure out which man truly has the most amazing spread.
Oh, this should be interesting.
Pants off, gentlemen.
Please do!
She won't be joining us? How awful.
So what, you're just gonna like... have everyone strip?
That would hardly be fair, Wisaka. You're hairier than both of them combined.
That's the second-best bracken I've ever seen! How could I not have known you had that?!
The armour's a lot heavier when it's wet, so I'm cold and exhausted, but I'll live.
The quality of a man's sprawl is the surest way to measure the quality of the man! Everybody knows that!
There was a time that this kind of behaviour would have shocked me, once long ago.
This is so undignified.
This is why you take your clothes off when you cross the water, like I did.
To give you guys some privacy so you can kiss and make up!
Ugh, you're all a bunch of idiots.
Wait, seriously? How does that-
Wait, you said I had the second-best bracken? If my chest hair is so amazing, who has the first-best?
Well I am something of an expert on the qualities of a real man's chest, so you can rest easy knowing that I'm well-qualified!
Well I do, obviously.
Well I don't know if I'm qualified to judge between two such exquisite gentlemen, but I'll do my best.
Well not on its own, of course, but it counts for something!
Well now I feel bad.
Well possibly because, unlike you, I am properly dressed most days.
Well then.
Well, I take it to mean you think me a good man, so I graciously accept your compliment.
Well, don't mind me. Just do your stuff.
Well, mine isn't just an unkempt tangle either, I'll have you know! And who gave you the authority to just declare yourself the best anyway?
What does it matter?!
What was that for? Not that I'm complaining.
Where are you going?
Yeah, me too. Sorry, I got carried away.
You can out-sword me any day, Greave, but in this, Bato is king. Sorry to say it!
You can take that kid, Bato!
You don't really believe that, do you?
You'd be surprised how many times guys in Hayill get into this exact argument.
You're both really stripping. I...
Tem

Finally, I am free! 

Is it you I have to thank?
Forgive my interruption, Master, but I must interject. This book is a trap, and a clumsy one at that. Allow me to take care of this.

I have been gagged and bound in that book for many mortal lifetimes.

My hunger is profound.
It's been taken care of. Here, a... remnant. You may find it useful.
Now, welcome my children into your bodies!
There is something wrong here. Give me a moment before you touch that thing.

You are fortunate I was here. It would have been very bad if you had opened that book. 

It has been taken care of, however. Shall we move on?
You, however, have served me well. You will be spared my hunger, and instead I offer an honoured place at my side, so you may serve me evermore!
I miss you.
In memory of our beloved hero, Maxim Spartill
Maxim. You really made a name for yourself didn't you?
A moment of weakness, perhaps.
A strange question coming from you. Are you taking an interest in us?
And I suppose you'd have begrudged him having children on account of the law you love so much?
And what did they think of their mother getting sent out to this rock?
Are your children also half-orcs, Moria?
Don't mock me, woman. I am ever mindful of ways to contribute to my master's power. Some day I may need to breed an army of warriors. Half-orcs seem a sensible choice.
He understands now. It is not easy, but he is helping his brother to understand as well.
Hm.
How long do humans keep their children around, anyway?
